verdict.rationale: Foreloop's homepage claims you can "Approve the big calls from your phone." Its docs say approval of a task contract is the gate before agents act, and that agents poll for approved tasks on a cadence and work them as they arrive, so they keep working while approvals happen. However, the phone part rests on a single marketing line, with no documented mobile app, mobile UI or notification flow. missing for 10: documentation of a mobile approval interface or app, push notifications for pending decisions, detail on which agent decisions besides contract approval can be approved, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: Approve the big calls from your phone.
Nothing runs until a person approves a contract. Approval is the only gate
The agent then checks Foreloop for approved tasks on a cadence and works them as they arrive.
